item.title: U18 REPORT | Carlisle United 2-1 Wrexham AFC
item.description: Wrexham AFC Under-18s suffered a 2-1 defeat away to Carlisle United in the EFL Youth Alliance North. In what was a battling performance, it was the young Red Dragons who broke the deadlock minutes into the second half as Joe Rees converted directly from a free kick. However, the hosts pulled two goals back through Dan Hopper and an own goal by Harry Wakenshaw to secure all three points. item.description: Professional Development Phase Lead Coach Craig Knight believed there were plenty of learning opportunities for his Under-18s side after they narrowly lost 2-1 away to Carlisle United. item.title: REPORT | Bristol City 2-2 Wrexham AFC
item.description: Ollie Rathbone scored his sixth goal of the season as Wrexham drew away to Bristol City at Ashton Gate. Rathbone gave Wrexham a deserved half-time lead, but the Robins shuffled their pack at the interval and hit back immediately through Sinclair Armstrong. Joe Williams put through his own net to give Wrexham the lead again, but Max Bird volleyed in a brilliant equaliser to snatch a point.
